title: GTA 6 Sets Entertainment Records With $2.3bn in Sales
excerpt: Rockstar Games has launched Grand Theft Auto 6, which industry estimates indicate is the biggest entertainment launch ever after a 13-year wait.
body_html:
Rockstar Games has concluded a 13-year wait with the release of Grand Theft Auto 6, which is projected to be the largest entertainment launch in history.

According to industry estimates, sales for the highly anticipated title have already reached $2.3 billion.
